title: Situs Unduh Game Berbasis Iklan
desc:
Saya membutuhkan sebuah situs web yang memungkinkan pengunjung mengunduh game mobile sekaligus menghasilkan pendapatan iklan. Fokus utama proyek ini adalah monetisasi—setiap halaman unduh harus memiliki penempatan banner atau interstitial yang optimal tanpa mengganggu pengalaman pengguna.

Ruang lingkup inti:
• Halaman beranda yang menampilkan daftar game mobile terbaru, terpopuler, dan rekomendasi.  
• Halaman detail game berisi deskripsi, tangkapan layar, ukuran file, versi, serta tombol unduh.  
• Sistem manajemen konten sederhana agar saya bisa menambah, mengedit, atau menghapus game tanpa pengetahuan teknis mendalam.  
• Integrasi jaringan iklan (Google AdSense atau setara) pada posisi strategis: header, sidebar, dan dalam halaman unduh.  
• Fitur pencarian dan kategori untuk memudahkan pengguna menemukan game.  
• Desain responsif sehingga nyaman diakses lewat smartphone maupun desktop.  
• Optimasi kecepatan dan SEO dasar agar halaman cepat dimuat dan mudah terindeks.  
• Dashboard analitik bawaan atau terhubung ke Google Analytics untuk memantau performa iklan dan trafik.

Kriteria keberhasilan:
– Situs aktif dan bisa diakses publik tanpa bug kritis.  
– Iklan tampil sesuai penempatan yang telah disepakati dan tidak menutupi tombol unduh.  
– Proses unggah/unduh game lancar di perangkat mobile.  
– Dokumentasi singkat tentang cara menambah game dan mengganti slot iklan.

Saya membutuhkan penyelesaian secepatnya (segera). Silakan jelaskan pendekatan teknis Anda—apakah

title: Corporate Web Dev Referral Partner

We have also ready product for sale , Microfinane Loan Software, NIDHI Company Finance Management Software Hotel Management Software, Laundry Service Market Place Software.

• Java / Spring Boot and Microservices
• React, Angular, Next.js and TypeScript
• Python / FastAPI / Flask
• PHP / Laravel
• Mobile App Development
• SQL / MySQL / PostgreSQL / MongoDB
• Azure, AWS and DevOps

How the partnership works:
You identify and introduce a genuine client/project that requires software development. We handle the technical discussion, estimation, development and delivery with the client.

If you have software projects or clients looking for a reliable development team, please contact us with the project details and your preferred partnership arrangement.

title: Google Ads Growth Campaigns -- 2
desc:
I run Sabar Growth, a remote performance-marketing consultancy serving clients across Dubai, the wider UAE, Oman and the GCC. The next growth phase calls for a dedicated Google Ads partner who can take full ownership of strategy, build and continual optimisation.

Scope of work  
• Audit any existing accounts and tracking to surface wasted spend and missed opportunities  
• Design a data-driven campaign structure aligned with qualified-lead and sales targets  
• Implement conversion tracking (GA4, GTM, offline imports) so every dirham is attributable  
• Launch and manage Search, Display or Shopping formats as required, refining bids, audiences and creative in real time  
• Report weekly on CAC, ROAS and net new revenue, with clear optimisation actions

Acceptance criteria  
• Campaigns go live error-free, fully tracked and approved within the agreed timeline  
• CAC and ROAS targets, set together before launch, are met or beaten for two consecutive optimisation cycles  
• All learnings, ad copies, keyword lists and reports are shared in editable format (Sheets, Looker Studio, Data Studio)

You will be working directly with me, so expect quick feedback, crisp KPIs and room to test bold ideas. Experience across GCC markets, Arabic/English ad copy and a portfolio of successful Google Ads case studies will stand out.

Ready to scale results? Share two recent Google Ads wins and the exact numbers you moved.

title: SCARA Robot Design and Development -- 2
desc:
Design & Development of 3-Axis SCARA Robot – Mechanical, Electronics, Firmware & ROS2 Software

Project Description

We are looking for an experienced Robotics/Mechatronics Engineer or Robotics Development Team to design and develop a 3-axis SCARA robot based on the performance and functionality of an existing commercial SCARA robot such as the Oriental Motor OVR series.

The goal is to develop an independently engineered robot design, including mechanical design, electronics, firmware, control software and ROS2 integration. The final design should be suitable for prototyping and future commercial development.

Important: We are looking for an original/independently engineered design, not a direct copy of any manufacturer's proprietary CAD, drawings, firmware or software.

Target Specifications
3-axis SCARA robot
Approx. 400–450 mm working reach
Approx. 3 kg payload
2 rotary joints + Z axis
High repeatability target: approximately ±0.03–0.05 mm
24/48 VDC operation
Closed-loop motors with encoders
Industrial-quality mechanical construction
Modular and serviceable design
Scope of Work

1. Mechanical Design

Complete 3D CAD model
Base, arms, joints and Z-axis mechanism
Motor and reducer selection
Bearings, shafts and couplings
Cable management
End-effector mounting
Manufacturing drawings
Assembly drawings
GD&T and tolerances
Complete BOM
Design suitable for CNC/aluminium manufacturing

2. Electronics

Motor/actuator architecture
Motor drivers
Encoder interface
Main controller PC

title: AutoCAD Automation Prototype
desc:
We are looking for an experienced AutoLISP developer to develop and demonstrate an automation concept inside AutoCAD.

Using one of our existing AutoCAD drawings as the base, the prototype should:

Automatically generate a new drawing based on user-supplied parameters such as dimensions, connection points, component locations, annotations, etc.
Automatically update the relevant geometry, dimensions and annotations based on the selected parameters.
Reuse our existing drawing standards, blocks, layers and templates wherever practical.
Demonstrate a simple on-screen visual simulation/parametric movement or clearance check within the same DWG.
Be designed in a way that the workflow can later be expanded to additional drawing types.
Technical Requirements
Must run natively inside AutoCAD.
AutoLISP only for the first phase.
No external add-ins or separate software.
Clean, structured and commented .LSP source code.
User-friendly AutoCAD command for entering parameters.
The generated output should remain fully editable in AutoCAD.
Source code must be delivered in editable format.

title: TO-3 Transistor Datasheet Redesign & Correction

The current PDF has one factual error, a couple of unverified/unsupported spec entries, and is missing several parameters that should be present when checked against the manufacturer's reference datasheet (ON Semiconductor's 2N3773 sheet, which we're treating as the source of truth).

What we're providing:

The current PPD datasheet (PDF)
A detailed change brief (Word doc) listing every correction, removal, and addition needed — old value → new value, exact test conditions, and where each item belongs in the layout
The ON Semiconductor reference datasheet for cross-checking

What we need done:

Apply all the corrections/additions/removals listed in the brief
Rebuild page 2 (package/mechanical info) from an editable source — the current PDF has that page as a single flattened image with no text layer, so it can't be text-edited and needs to be reconstructed
Keep our existing branding, layout style, colors, and logo consistent across both pages
Make sure the footer (document number, revision, release date) matches exactly across both pages, with only the page number differing
Deliver an editable source file (InDesign, Illustrator, Figma, or similar — your choice) plus a final print-ready PDF

Ideal skills: technical/electronics datasheet design, layout & typesetting, comfort reading component spec sheets, attention to detail on numeric tables.

title: Traditional Wedding Album Layout
desc:
I’m ready to have our wedding memories transformed into a beautifully designed 12x12-inch album with a timeless, traditional layout. The final book should flow naturally from the ceremony through to the key family portraits, capturing the emotion and formality of the day without veering into modern or vintage styling.

Here’s what I’ll need from you:  
• Page-by-page design files (InDesign or Photoshop, layered and print-ready)  
• High-resolution PDF proof for review  
• One round of revisions to fine-tune photo placement or captions  

Acceptance criteria  
• Classic margins, balanced white space, and elegant typography consistent across all spreads  
• All ceremony photos and family portraits placed prominently, sequenced to tell a clear story  
• Final export set to the printer’s exact 12x12-inch bleed and color profile specifications  

If you’ve created similar traditional albums before and understand print-ready preparation, I’d love to see a couple of samples alongside your proposal.

title: Accurate PDF-to-Word Conversion
desc:
I have a batch of PDFs that must be turned into fully editable .docx files while keeping the layout looking the same to the naked eye—headings, tables, images, page breaks, everything. Some files are straightforward text, others mix graphics and scanned pages, so you’ll need reliable OCR alongside solid formatting skills in Word, Adobe Acrobat, ABBYY FineReader or similar tools.

What I will send you: a folder of original PDFs, numbered in sequence.  
What I expect back: a matching set of .docx files, each one named exactly like its source. I’ll compare the Word version side-by-side with the PDF; if spacing, bullet alignment or images shift noticeably, I’ll ask for a quick adjustment.

Deliverables  
• One clean, editable Word document per PDF supplied  
• All fonts embedded or substituted so there are no missing-font warnings on open

Once the first file passes review, we’ll move through the rest at an agreed daily page rate. Let me know how many pages you can comfortably convert each day and which software you prefer to use so I can plan the schedule.

title: Commission-Driven Client Acquisition Caller
desc:
I need a self-starting sales professional who can turn raw data into paying customers. Your day will begin by scraping and compiling fresh lead lists, then moving straight into 30–40 focused cold calls aimed at retail and local shops, restaurants, hotels, real-estate firms, construction companies, salons & beauty studios, fitness centers, schools, healthcare providers, automotive businesses, small enterprises and e-commerce brands.  

The goal on every call is simple: introduce our services, qualify interest, and push qualified prospects toward conversion. When a prospect shows intent, you’ll nurture the relationship with timely follow-ups until the deal closes. Throughout the process you’ll keep our lead sheet or CRM updated so I can see real-time progress.

Compensation is performance-oriented: ₹1,000 fixed each month plus a 10 % commission on every client who signs. That commission has no cap, so the more deals you bring in, the higher your earnings climb.

Deliverables I expect:
• A clean, growing lead spreadsheet with contact details and industry tags  
• Daily notes on calls made, outcomes, and next steps  
• Weekly summary of conversions so we can release commissions quickly  

If you already have experience in cold calling, lead generation, or business development, you’ll hit the ground running. Let’s start closing new clients together.

title: Daily Customer Data Entry
desc:
I need help maintaining a live Google Sheets file where new customer contact information is added every single day. You’ll receive raw details from our CRM export, copy-edit for consistency (names, email addresses, phone numbers, ZIP codes), then insert them into the correct columns without disturbing existing formulas or sorting rules.   

Accuracy and swift turnaround are critical because the sheet drives our daily outreach. I update the source file by 5 p.m. GMT and expect the cleaned, fully entered records back in the shared sheet before 10 a.m. the next morning, Monday through Friday.  

When you send your proposal, focus on a clear outline of your approach: how you’ll keep errors to a minimum, handle duplicate detection, and automate repetitive steps inside Google Sheets (e.g., using data validation, conditional formatting, or simple Apps Script if you prefer). A concise, step-by-step plan will help me choose quickly.  

The engagement will start with a one-day paid trial; if everything lines up—speed, accuracy, and communication—we’ll roll into an ongoing arrangement.

title: Revit 3D Rebar Modeling Specialist Needed

If Phase 1 is executed successfully, there is a strong pipeline of additional structural elements and future phases waiting.

Software Provision Note: Selected candidates will be provided direct access to official Autodesk Revit and Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) licenses for the duration of this project.

Detailed Scope of Work (Phase 1)
1.	Document Interpretation & 3D Rebar Modeling: Carefully interpret structural rebar layout documents, schedules, and cross-sections (such as provided sample sheets) to model accurate 3D reinforcement for the 19 beam types in Autodesk Revit, adhering to cover, lap splices, and anchorage requirements.

title: Excel Sales Data Reformat & Percentages
desc:
I’m supplying a raw Excel file that lists recent sales, and I need it cleaned up so the information is easy to read and work with. The task has two parts:

• First, re-arrange or tidy the sheet wherever it’s messy—uniform column headers, clear number formats, and a logical flow that makes future filtering or pivoting straightforward.

• Second, build in the one basic calculation I do require: percentage-change formulas that compare figures across the relevant periods already in the data. These should auto-fill down the sheet so updated numbers recalculate instantly.

Keep everything in a single workbook, no external links, and please label any new columns you add. Once finished, I should be able to hand the file to a colleague who can grasp the structure immediately and trust the percentage calculations are correct.

title: Informatica-Driven SAP HANA Migration
desc:
I need an experienced Informatica specialist to move data from our existing database landscape into SAP HANA. All mapping, transformation, and load activities must be built and executed in Informatica so we keep auditability and re-usability of the workflows.

Scope  
• Analyse the current schemas and provide a detailed migration plan.  
• Build Informatica mappings, sessions, and workflows that stage, cleanse, and load the data into SAP HANA tables.  
• Reconcile record counts and key metrics to verify 100 % accuracy post-load.  
• Supply runbooks and source files so my in-house team can repeat the process.

Environment & tools  
Informatica PowerCenter 10.x is already installed; access to SAP HANA database schemas and development accounts will be granted. If you prefer complementary tools such as Informatica Data Quality for profiling, let me know so I can arrange licenses in advance.

Timeline  
The full migration and validation must be wrapped up within a month, so please outline a realistic schedule with milestones, including unit tests and final sign-off.

Acceptance criteria  
• All target tables in SAP HANA populated as per mapping specs.  
• Zero data loss and no integrity violations; referential constraints validated.  
• Complete technical documentation (mapping spec, workflow screenshots, and runbook).  

Share a brief note on similar SAP HANA loads you have executed with Informatica and highlight any performance-tuning techniques you typically apply.

title: Omnichannel Brand Awareness Campaign
desc:

If you excel at orchestrating multi-platform campaigns that leave a lasting impression, I look forward to reviewing your proposal.

Please research SMEs in:

* France
* Wallonia, Belgium

You will:

title: Review Stock Market Product use case Architecture
desc:
I have built a real-time Indian stock-market product and now need a fresh, expert eye on the underlying technical architecture. I want you to dive deep, question every assumption, and provide clear, actionable feedback on two fronts in particular:  

- Architecture and use case diagrams and challenge and understand the issues associated if any
- Scalability when this goes beyond initial limits

What I expect from you  
1. An architectural review document (PDF or Markdown) that maps the current components, pinpoints bottlenecks or overlap, and explains trade-offs.  
2. A prioritised set of recommendations, each with an estimated effort level and expected impact.  

Your experience in finance-grade systems will weigh heavily in my selection. If you have previously optimised high-throughput trading or analytics platforms, tell me about it when you apply; that context will help me trust your advice.  

No need for a full-blown security audit right now—though if that’s in your wheelhouse we can tackle it later. For this engagement, clarity, depth and candour on scale and integration are what matter most.

title: Plain Text Data Entry
desc:
I have a batch of plain-text (.txt) documents that need to be lifted out of their current loose-file state and entered accurately into a structured format. The job is straightforward: open each file, copy the contents exactly as they appear (preserving line breaks and basic punctuation), and paste them into the destination I provide—most often an Excel sheet, though I’m open to a Google Sheet if that is easier for you.

Consistency and zero-error typing are critical. All characters, including special symbols or accent marks, must carry over intact, and you’ll flag any unreadable fragments so I can review them. 

When you deliver, I’ll check:
• Every source file is accounted for.  
• Text matches the original byte-for-byte (no dropped lines, doubled spaces, or smart-quote substitutions).  
• Sheet rows remain in the same order as my file list.

Once everything passes that spot check, I release the milestone and we move on to the next folder. If you work quickly and cleanly, there will be additional batches ready straight away.

title: Calm Instagram Reels Editing
desc:
I shoot short “video editar” clips for Instagram and need someone who can turn that raw footage into polished Reels that feel smooth, relaxed, and effortlessly watchable. Think gentle pacing, tasteful instrumental beds, and transitions that glide instead of snap.

What matters most to me is flow: colour-matched shots, subtle motion graphics where they help, and audio levels that keep the music present without overpowering any spoken bits. I usually deliver vertical 1080×1920 files, plus any brand assets, and I’d like the finished reel returned in the same resolution (MP4, H.264), ready to post. If you’re cutting in Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut I’m fine—use whatever you’re fastest in, just export cleanly.

Once we start, I’ll provide:
• Raw footage (Google Drive link)  
• A short brief for each reel (storyline, duration target, text overlays if needed)  
• Brand font and colour codes  

You’ll return:
• Final edited Reel  
• One thumbnail image pulled from the edit  
• Optional: the project file so I can make tiny tweaks later if needed  

Smooth transitions, calm pacing, and instrumental music are non-negotiable. If that’s your style too, let’s get a reel underway this week.

title: Publish Articles on Guest Sites
desc: You need to post guest blog posting on the agreed websites. Write basic content using chatgpt and link with given landing pages.

title: Short Film Edit Assistance
desc:
I’m sitting on a folder of raw footage for a narrative short and need a sharp-eyed editor to transform it into a seamless final cut. The goal is simple: get the video fully edited so it plays smoothly from first frame to last.

You’ll receive all takes, reference notes, and a draft script that lays out the intended flow. I’m open to your creative suggestions—whether that means tightening pacing, grading the colour for a consistent mood, or weaving in tasteful transitions and effects where they add impact. Audio is already cleaned, so your main focus stays on the picture edit.

Please work in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or another professional NLE you’re comfortable with; I’ll need the finished 1080p file plus the project file so I can archive the timeline. One revision pass is included to fine-tune timing or minor aesthetic tweaks after I review the first export.

If you thrive on shaping story through rhythm and visuals, let’s get started.

title: Embedded Electronics + Custom PCB + Firmware + Offline Wi-Fi Web HMI for Motorized Gaming Target Retrieval System
desc:

I am developing a battery-operated motorised target retrieval system for a shooting/training range.

The system consists of a motorised retrieval mechanism, BLDC motor with an encoder, Gaming target rotation mechanism using a servo motor, battery-operated electronics, and a Wi-Fi-enabled camera.

I am looking for an experienced **Embedded Systems / IoT / Robotics / Industrial Automation Engineer** who can develop the complete electronics, firmware and local web-based control system.

This is a product-development project. I am looking for someone who can take the system from prototype architecture through custom PCB, firmware, testing and a working prototype.

## Main Requirement

The complete machine must be operated from a tablet through a web browser.

The system must work **without Internet access**.

The machine itself should create its own Wi-Fi network.

Example:

**Tablet → Wi-Fi → Retrieval System**

The operator should connect the tablet directly to the machine's Wi-Fi and open the control interface through a web browser.

No cloud server, SIM card, external Internet connection or external Wi-Fi router should be required for normal operation.

## Main Hardware

The system will include:

1. BLDC motor for retrieval movement
2. Encoder connected to the BLDC motor
3. BLDC motor driver/controller
4. Servo motor for target rotation
5. Battery-powered power system
6. Battery monitoring
7. Wi-Fi-enabled embedded controller
8. Wi-Fi camera

desc:

title: ESP32/ATmega328 Industrial PCB Design
desc:
I’m consolidating an existing prototype into a single industrial-grade PCB that hosts an ESP32 module for wireless connectivity and an ATmega328 for deterministic tasks. The board’s main job is high-accuracy sensor data collection, but it must also drive several stepper motors, so clean analogue front-ends and rock-solid power electronics need to live happily beside 24 V motor drivers.

Scope  
• Schematic capture that merges the two MCUs, level-shifting and all necessary isolation between the low-noise sensor domain and the higher-current motor domain.  
• PCB layout ready for fabrication: four-layer minimum, controlled impedance where appropriate, wide creepage on the power stage, and industrial connectors (Phoenix-style) for field wiring.  
• Integrated 5 V/3.3 V regulators sourced from a 24 V rail, plus reverse-polarity, surge and ESD protection.  
• BOM with readily available parts and suggested alternates.  
• Manufacturing files: Gerbers, drill, pick-and-place and assembly drawings.  
• Brief bring-up firmware that shows sensor acquisition on the ATmega328, hands data to the ESP32 over UART/I²C, and drives a NEMA 17 stepper via a standard driver (e.g., DRV8825).

Acceptance  
The design should pass basic ERC/DRC, compile in KiCad 7 (Altium acceptable if you provide a tagged release archive), and be electrically reviewed through a quick design-for-manufacture report. I’m not on a tight clock, so we can iterate on the layout until it’s production-ready; quality and maint

title: 80-Acre Villa Masterplan
desc:
I have 80 acres (soon to reach 100) that I want turned into a clear, build-ready masterplan for three separate villa communities. Each community must sit on its own 25–30 acre parcel, all linked by a primary road that enters directly from the highway, weaves through the site and branches off to each parcel. 

Every parcel is envisioned for modern villas only—clean lines, generous setbacks, plenty of light and private outdoor space. Please organise the lots so each development can operate independently yet still read as part of one overall estate.

A fourth parcel of about 3 acres, positioned centrally for equal access, is reserved for a sports clubhouse.
